rules.taskRoleCompatibility: Training data augmentation remains taskRole=training_proxy, with taskSubRole=training_augmentation as audit metadata only. Do not silently extend the model relation Schema or role vocabulary from a review CSV.
rules.priorityScope: Only the five nominated UNRESOLVED mention pairs may change labels. Two nominated evaluation chains receive antecedent/coreference spans; the same SQuAD chain is also attached to its existing alias pair. Existing entities, candidate universe, other labels and five quarantined negatives remain unchanged.
rules.evidence: Use full literal source spans, never evidenceHint as replacement text. Preserve prior evidence and reasons for evidence-only changes. Support links record AI discourse interpretation, not authenticated semantic proof.
rules.replay: Offline standard-library checker validates frozen exports and bindings without models or Neo4j. Deliver controlled source/test snapshots and historical failure XML separately; do not claim it reruns training or the complete original environment-dependent suite.
